name: @janssenproject/cedarling
description: Web-native JavaScript SDK for Cedarling authorization

scripts.build: npm run clean && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json && node scripts/build.mjs
scripts.test:prepare: npm run build && npm run test:compile
scripts.test:portable:bun: npm run test:prepare && npm run test:portable:bun:run
scripts.test:portable:deno: npm run test:prepare && npm run test:portable:deno:run
scripts.test:browser:firefox-esr: npm run test:prepare && npm run test:browser:build && npm run test:browser:firefox-esr:run
scripts.test:browser: npm run test:prepare && npm run test:browser:build && npm run test:browser:run
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run test:prepare && node .test-dist/runners/node.js unit && node .test-dist/runners/node.js contract && node scripts/verify-consumer.mjs
scripts.check:all: npm run check && npm run test:portable:bun:run && npm run test:portable:deno:run && npm run test:browser:build && npm run test:browser:run && npm run test:browser:firefox-esr:run
